overview.description: The Calamos S&P 500 Structured Alt Protection ETF (CPSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the return of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a one-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure CPSM was launched on May 1, 2024 and is issued by Calamos.
